subject: Mutual action plan and evaluation schedule — tranche-based discount request
messages:
From: Claire Doucet <claire@astranova.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luke Price <luke.price@astranova.com>
Date: 2026-12-11T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Mutual action plan + discount ask for eval -> production ramp

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Luke and I walked the team through the Redwood runtime and the token economics looks promising for our recommendation engine pilot. We followed up internally and want to propose a short MAP and evaluation plan that ties a staged discount schedule to clear ramp milestones so we can get to production quickly.

High-level ask (attached: AstraNova_MAP_v3.pdf, eval-metrics.xlsx):
- 6-week technical evaluation (pilot) starting 01/04/2027: pilot discount 12% off list pricing
- Production ramp to 60M tokens/month within 3 months of pilot success: additional tranche to 18%
- 12-month committed ARR (post-ramp) -> final tranche total 22% (ties to min monthly commitment)

Open items for your team: minimum annual commit threshold for the final tranche, billing terms (Net 45 vs Net 30), and a short SLA (latency p95). We're flexible on the exact gating metrics — we included experimental target metrics in eval-metrics.xlsx.

We'd like a decision by 12/17 so our procurement and engineering can align calendar needs. Can you route this to the right folks for commercial approval? If helpful, Luke can jump on a call this week.

Appreciate it,
Claire
Head of Product
AstraNova

(Attachment: AstraNova_MAP_v3.pdf, eval-metrics.xlsx)

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-11T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Mutual action plan + discount ask for eval -> production ramp

Team — forwarding AstraNova's MAP and discount schedule request. Summary below and ask for commercial clearance.

Summary of request (from Claire):
- Pilot: 6 weeks starting 2027-01-04, 12% discount
- Ramp: 60M tokens/month within 3 months after pilot success -> additional discount to 18%
- Commit: 12-month contract after ramp -> total 22%
- Requests Net 45 and an SLA for p95 latency (they want p95 < 450ms)

My read: strategic vertical (recommendation engines), good logos, asks are aggressive on tranches (22% final). We can accept staged discounts if we get solid commitment language + minimum monthly committed tokens and QBRs. Legal will want tighter wording on "pilot success" gating.

Questions for you:
1) Ben — commercial tolerance? can we do pilot 12% and ramp to 18% on clear commit, but cap total at 18% unless we escalate?
2) Rishi — finance: can we accept Net 45 for this, and what's P&L impact of 22% vs 18% (I attached the financial-impact-model.xlsx for modeling)?
3) Grace — CS input: guess on operational risk for SLA and onboarding timeline; will we need dedicated onboarding support?

Next steps I'm proposing:
- Internal decision by EOD 12/14 so I can reply to Claire with a commercial proposal and adjusted MAP (we should also provide the minimum committed tokens per month for each tranche).
- If >18% discount needed, escalate to VP of Sales (Ben) + CFO (Rishi) for approval; anything >20% requires exec review per playbook.

I've attached their MAP and our redlines doc (redlines.docx). Please reply with: approve / approve-with-conditions / escalate.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

(Attachments: AstraNova_MAP_v3.pdf, eval-metrics.xlsx, redlines.docx, financial-impact-model.xlsx)

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-12T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Mutual action plan + discount ask for eval -> production ramp

Folks — quick thoughts after a pass on the redlines and the impact model:

- Commercial position: I'm comfortable with pilot at 12% (timeboxed 6 weeks). For post-pilot ramp, we should require a signed "ramp commitment" that defines min tokens/month for the 60M target and milestones at 20M / 40M / 60M. Hit each milestone to unlock the next tranche.
- Discount tranches: suggest we change to 12% (pilot) -> 15% (on achieving 40M sustained for 30 days) -> 18% (on achieving 60M sustained for 60 days). This protects us from over-discounting early.
- Final 22%: I do not want to grant 22% unless there's an explicit 12-month minimum ARR commit with financial penalties for shortfall. Anything approaching 20%+ needs CFO sign-off; anything >20% gets routed to execs.
- Net 45: acceptable only if they provide an auto-renewing card-on-file or committed ARR structure; otherwise insist on Net 30 for pilot/initial billing.

Grace — can you confirm whether we can provide the onboarding window and dedicate a solutions engineer for the 6-week pilot? If yes, I'll present this as our commercial counter.

I'll model the three-tranche scenario in the financial-impact spreadsheet and flag to Rishi where it hits our thresholds.

Ben Carter
VP, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: financial-impact-model.xlsx)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-14T15:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Mutual action plan + discount ask for eval -> production ramp

Thanks — reviewed Ben's proposal and the impact model. Finance position: APPROVE the revised tranche plan (12% pilot; 15% at 40M; 18% at 60M) with conditions:

1) Require a minimum monthly committed token floor (we should set this in the contract; suggest 30M as a baseline to qualify for any post-pilot discount).
2) Final 18% is contingent on a signed 12-month commitment and creditworthy contract terms; if they push for Net 45, accept for the pilot only with a pre-paid deposit equal to one month of expected usage.
3) Add clawback language for missed commitments (prorated true-up).

If Ben wants to pursue anything above 18%, escalate to the CEO per the discount authority matrix. Otherwise I'm good to have Legal convert the redlines and for Stephanie to send the counter to AstraNova.

Rishi Malhotra
Chief Financial Officer
Redwood Inference

[Quick reply to finalize: Stephanie — if you send the counter with those guardrails by 12/17, Finance will sign off on the contract once legal inserts the commit language.]
